# Organization

[dotfiles](../README.md) › Organization

The pages of this repo follow an org chart: six directorates, each split into divisions, each division into branches.
The chart arranges the pages only; the code stays where the flake, `dram`, the installer and the hosts expect it.
[`docs/map.tsv`](map.tsv) places every tracked file in a directorate, a division and a branch, and `bin/check.sh` §22 reports a file it doesn't place.

## Kinds of page

| Kind | What it does | Where it lives |
|---|---|---|
| Directorate page | indexes its divisions and states the rules that hold across them | `docs/<directorate>/README.md` |
| Division page | says what the division covers and lists its branches | `docs/<directorate>/<division>/README.md` |
| Branch page | explains one branch that spans several modules: how it works, how to use it, how it fails | `docs/<directorate>/<division>/<branch>.md` |
| Module README | a part someone can copy alone: what it needs, how to copy it, how it is wired here | next to its code |
| Handbook | tasks, step by step, with real output | [`docs/records/handbook/`](records/handbook/README.md) |
| Decision record and log | why things are the way they are | [`decisions/`](../decisions/README.md) |
| Generated page | written by a script from the files that hold the facts | [commands](commands.md), [keybinds](design/shell-and-bars/keybinds.md), [catalogue](catalogue.md), [decision index](../decisions/README.md) |

Each kind has a template in [`docs/records/templates/`](records/templates/README.md).
How the pages are written: [the style guide](records/style.md).
What can be copied alone: [the catalogue](catalogue.md).

## Adding a branch

1. Add a row to `docs/map.tsv` for its paths; the last row that matches a path wins.
2. Give it a page from the template: a module README next to its code when it is one module, or `docs/<directorate>/<division>/<branch>.md` when it spans several.
3. Add it to its division page's branch table.
4. Run `bash bin/check.sh`: §6 checks the links, §22 the map, §23 the generated pages.

A new division or directorate is a chart row in `docs/map.tsv` (a line that starts with `=`) and its README; `python3 bin/gen-org-doc.py` then redraws the chart here and on the front page.

## Frozen pages

[`docs/history/`](history/README.md) holds dated pages about how the hosts got where they are.
They describe an older tree with the names and commands of their time, are not maintained, and the link check leaves them out.
